namespace Finset
variable {α : Type*} {s t : Finset α}

lemma card_lt_card_iff_of_subset (hst : s ⊆ t) : #s < #t ↔ s ≠ t := by
  rw [← not_le, eq_iff_card_le_of_subset hst]

end Finset
